clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Within about a year and a half of your sister Bea's birth in 1995, you said your mother Lena grew worn out and on edge, your parents' distance grew with your father Paul working late, your own stomach aches and missed school came on, shouting matches started between your father Paul and your brother Jonah, and your mother did not go back to her job, held as a guess that the family's balance shifted around the new baby; your move to the city in 2003 and Rosa's death in 2007 sit too far off in time to belong with these.
